content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Translations and Multi-Language Events ## slug: translations-multi-language-events ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Blackthorn has multiple translation options for {{variable.Object_Event}}s that will fit various use cases. :::(Warning) (Static Translations Feature now in Beta!) Please reach out to our support team if you'd like to participate in as an early adopter! ::: ## Multi-language Events :::(Info) (**Functionality Updates**) The following changes only apply to Translations using Google’s API: * If a {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} is set on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}}, the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} will automatically be displayed in that language. Language can be changed by the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} (if enabled). * If a {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} **is NOT set** on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}}, then the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} will automatically be displayed in the language related to the user’s browser locale setting. Language can be changed by the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} (if enabled). * If a {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} is set on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} related to an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}}, then the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} will automatically be displayed in that language. Language can be changed by the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} (if enabled). * If a {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} **is NOT set** on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} related to an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}}, then the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} will automatically be displayed in the language related to the user’s browser locale setting. Language can be changed by the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} (if enabled). ::: Blackthorn harnesses the power of Google Translate as the basis of our {{variable.Product_Events}} translation capabilities. By default, with no specific Salesforce configuration, {{variable.Object_Event}} pages load in English. A user may change the language by using the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ![D_02_07_Translations 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_02_07_Translations%201.png){height="" width=""} From your {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record, you can also: * Set the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_LangSelecto}} to "Off" to hide it from your {{variable.Object_Event}} pages. * Choose a default {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} for your {{variable.Object_Event}}. This will ensure the {{variable.Object_Event}} loads in the selected language and can be used with or without the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_LangSelecto}} being set. * If the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} = "Spanish", then the user must enter text in Spanish instead of in English. * If the Event information is entered in English and the user wants it to be translated by the language selector, then {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SourceLangu}} = "blank." * Filter the list of available languages a user can choose from by selecting specific languages in the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SupportLang}} picklist. ![D_02_07_Translations 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_02_07_Translations%202.png){height="" width=""} ## Translation Overrides While using the Google Translate API is beneficial and provides a quick path for Event Planners to translate {{variable.Object_Event}}s’ pages, we also recognize that these translations may not always be picture perfect or accurate. We now have two great options to choose from to ensure you are able to provide accurately translated pages to your users and {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. ### Data Dictionary Our {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} feature can be utilized to override inaccurately translated button labels and static text on your {{variable.Object_Event}} pages. We also support multi-language {{variable.Object_Event}}s with this feature. When setting up Data {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntries}}, you can specify different overrides with different languages of the same button label or static text. For information on configuring the {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}}, please refer to [this page](/v1/docs/data-dictionary#override-labels-and-button-text). ### Static Translations (Beta) The Static Translations feature is now in Beta! Similar to the functionality of the {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} override capability, we now have a solution which allows an Event Planner to override or simply write their own Translations in place of Google Translate's auto-translation. The feature supports multi-language events as well! #### Requirements * Use our {{variable.Link_CandyShop}} to install or upgrade to Blackthorn Events 3.56 or above. * Beta opt-in (please reach out to {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to submit a request). * Review Base Package documentation to learn about our new Translations object in Salesforce. * The {{variable.Field_Translation_Language}} field is a required field on the {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. #### Configuration Steps 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page and click the Upgrade tab. 2. Click {{variable.Button_ETAdmin_Upgr_TranslLayo}}, which will deploy all the supported fields to the {{variable.Object_Translation}} page layout. #### Important to Know * When an Event Admin creates a {{variable.Object_Translation}} record from a record related to an {{variable.Object_Event}}, both the {{variable.Object_Event}} lookup and the parent record lookup record are set automatically. * After creating a {{variable.Object_Translation}} record from a record related to an {{variable.Object_Event}}, the user will be blocked from setting more than one lookup on that {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. * {{variable.Object_Form}}s, {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s, {{variable.Object_FormElementCondition}}, {{variable.Object_FormBigListOption}}, and Keywords cannot have the {{variable.Field_Translation_Event}} lookup since each of the items listed can be used by multiple {{variable.Object_Event}}s. * A translation relationship should be created between the {{variable.Object_Event}} and {{variable.Object_EventItem}} every time a {{variable.Object_Form}} with translated {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s is re-used, whether it's applied on the {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_EventItem}} level. If a {{variable.Object_Form}} is used on the {{variable.Object_Event}} level, the translations from the {{variable.Object_Form}}’s {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s will display on all {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s only if a {{variable.Object_Translation}} record is created on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record where the {{variable.Object_Event}} and one of the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s are populated as lookups. No other information/translation should be filed on that {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. If a {{variable.Object_Form}} is used on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} level, the translations from the {{variable.Object_Form}}’s {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s will display on *one* {{variable.Object_EventItem}} only if a {{variable.Object_Translation}} record is created on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, as mentioned above. This means that if there are multiple {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s using the same {{variable.Object_Form}}, a new {{variable.Object_Translation}} record needs to be created for each {{variable.Object_Form}} so the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} can be related to an {{variable.Object_Event}}. No other information than the {{variable.Field_Translation_Event}}/{{variable.Field_Translation_EventItem}} lookups should be populated on the {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. A work around is to set the {{variable.Object_Form}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} level (described above); however, that would mean that that the {{variable.Object_Form}} would apply to all {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. ### Creating Translation Records :::(Info) (Duplicate Translation Records) If an Event Admin tries to create a duplicate Translation record from a related record with the same Language, they will be unable to save the record and will receive the following error message. “Only one Translation record can be created per parent record and language, such as one Translation per Session’s or Event Item’s language.” ::: 1. Navigate to an {{variable.Object_Event}} record and find the Translations {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Click the down arrow and then click {{variable.button_new}}. ![D_02_07_Translations 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_02_07_Translations%203.png){height="" width=""} 3. Select a value (language) for {{variable.Field_Translation_Language}}. **NOTE:** The value (language) selected here directly correlates with our {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} values on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. 4. Type or copy/paste your translated values directly into the equivalent fields on the {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. **NOTE:** You can only translate fields from a single record per {{variable.Object_Translation}} record. For example, if you have an {{variable.Object_Event}} with one {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and one {{variable.Object_Session}}. You will need to create three {{variable.Object_Translation}} records for the same language: one for the {{variable.Object_Event}} fields, one for the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} fields, and one for the {{variable.Object_Session}} fields. ![D_02_07_Translations 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_02_07_Translations%204.png){height="" width=""} 5. Save your Translation. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} or {{variable.Button_Events_Publish}} on your {{variable.Object_Event}}. 7. Launch your {{variable.Object_Event}} and change the {{variable.Task_LanguageSelector}} to match that of your {{variable.Object_Translation}} records. Success! You'll see that your static Translations are visible in place of the Google Translate translation. :::(Info) () When an Attendee selects a language on the Event page, all records related to that language will be queried. ::: ![D_02_07_Translations 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_02_07_Translations%205.png){height="" width=""} ### Objects and Fields Available for Translation :::(Info) (**Formatting Updates**) The following formatting has been updated to help with the translation of abbreviated months on the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} and {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} pages. * Abbreviated months (except for Event Group listings) * Old: JAN * New: 1 * Event Group listings * Old: Jan 2, 2022 * New: January 2, 2022 ::: #### Object: Event {{snippet.Translation_AvailEventFields}} #### Object: Event Item {{snippet.Translation_AvailEVItemFields}} #### Object: Session {{snippet.Translation_AvailSessionFields}} #### Object: Form {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormFields}} #### Object: Form Element {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormEleFields}} #### Object: Form Element Condition {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormElCoField}} #### Object: Form Big List Option {{snippet.Translation_AvailFmBigLiOField}} #### Object: Speaker {{snippet.Translation_AvailSpeakerFields}} #### Object: Sponsor {{snippet.Translation_AvailSponsorField}} #### Object: Track {{snippet.Translation_AvailTrackField}} #### Object: Custom Content {{snippet.Translation_AvailCustEVTaField}} #### Object: Event Content {{snippet.Translation_AvailEVContenField}} #### Object: Event FAQ {{snippet.Translation_AvailEventFAQField}} #### Object: FAQ Category {{snippet.Translation_AvailFAQCategField}} #### Object: FAQ Question {{snippet.Translation_AvailFAQQuestField}} #### Object: Keyword {{snippet.Translation_AvailKeywordField}} ### Translation Object Layout {{snippet.TranslationObject_PageLayout}}
